title: Thorn and Ember
author: P. M. Iversen
blurb: Freya Almeida, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
